🛞 How to Play

Welcome to Cute Tire Explorer! Control a single standalone 3D tire rolling smoothly on a friendly spherical Earth.

  • Mobile Joystick: Drag the left joystick 🛞 in any direction to steer and drive!
  • Jump: Tap 🦘 to bounce over terrain.
  • Turbo: Hold ⚡ to sprint at high speeds.
  • Horn: Tap 🎺 for cute squeaks!
  • Desktop Keys: W/A/S/D or Arrows, Space to bounce, Shift for turbo, H to honk, C to cycle camera.
  • Customizer: Tap 🎨 Customize to swap treads, rim faces, and clay colors live!
